answer: Stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a refundable deposit to register, and jury weight scales with locked stake and past verified work. An attacker spawning N fake identities must lock N deposits, so cost grows linearly with N, while the stake-weighted summit of influence stays fixed per dollar. Slashing provably duplicated or colluding answers burns the deposit, like a crystal fracture along one thread, making each fake identity a recurring loss.
